_comment: The NPCs that live a little: a short walk around their home cell now and then, and a line on
the map's general channel now and then (Jondo.Unity.Server/Managers/NpcLife.cs). Only while a
real player stands on the map; the bots are no audience. Read once at the first beat of the loop.
Opt-in: an NPC this file does not name never moves and never speaks. Leave merchants, bankers and
quest givers out, or give them radius 0 (lines only), so people find them where they always were.
npc     the NPC template id (as in spawns.json / datos/npcs_reales.json). Required.
map     only that placement's map; left out, every map the template stands on. A row with
the map wins over one without it.
radius  how far from home it may walk, 0..4 cells (more is held to 4). 0 never walks.
It walks on the map's main floor only, never onto an interactive, a player or
another NPC, every 20-60 s, a few cells at a time, and always heads back home.
name    the speaker shown on its lines. The server knows no NPC names (the client takes
them from its own data), so it has to be written here.
lines   what it says, in French; one picked at random every 1-3 minutes, and no map hears
two NPC lines closer than 40 s. Empty or left out: it never speaks.
A row that neither walks nor speaks is ignored.

npcs.name: Astrubien paranoïaque
lines: Vous avez vu ? Ce bouftou me suit depuis ce matin...
Ne regardez pas le zaap trop longtemps, il vous regarde aussi.
Chut ! Ils écoutent. Ils écoutent toujours.

npcs.name: Tokageko
lines: Le vent d'Astrub porte bien des histoires, voyageur.
Prenez le temps de souffler avant de repartir à l'aventure.

npcs.name: Chevalier d'Astrub
lines: Les rues d'Astrub sont sûres tant que je veille.
Circulez, circulez, rien à voir ici !

npcs.name: Bontarien énervé
lines: Bonta vaincra ! Brâkmar n'a qu'à bien se tenir.
Encore une Brâkmarienne qui me regarde de travers...

npcs.name: Brâkmarienne énervée
lines: Les Bontariens et leurs grands airs, quelle plaie !
Un jour, Astrub choisira le bon camp. Le nôtre.

npcs.name: Cindy Cato
lines: Quelle belle journée pour une balade en ville !
Vous n'auriez pas vu passer un tofu égaré ?
